Description: Diff-aware re-scan: on a new commit, only re-run the agent on changed test files (shares file-list logic with Phase 6's PR scanner).

Title: Human review workflow for AI test cases
Description: Human review workflow for AI-reverse-engineered test cases: PENDING_REVIEW -> APPROVED/REJECTED status, diff view (AI output vs. edited-by-human).

Title: Edit-and-resubmit feedback capture
Description: Edit-and-resubmit: when a human edits an AI-generated test case, capture that as a labeled example; periodically review edit patterns to tighten the system prompt.

Title: Confidence-based review triage queue
Description: Confidence-based triage: auto-surface all test cases below a configurable confidence threshold into a review queue.

Title: Batch cost/latency controls for agent calls
Description: Batch cost/latency controls: chunk large files, cap concurrent agent calls, add per-org rate limiting on reverse-engineering jobs.

Title: Prompt regression test suite
Description: Prompt regression test suite: a fixed set of sample test files (one per known framework) with expected BDD output, run in CI to catch prompt-change regressions.

Title: File/zip upload support for reverse-engineering
Description: File upload support (not just paste) - zip of a test directory, single file upload.

Title: Postman/Newman collection import to BDD
Description: Postman/Newman collection import -> BDD (structurally different from code-based frameworks: request/assertion pairs, not functions).

Title: Gherkin/.feature file import
Description: Gherkin/.feature file import - already BDD; this path validates/normalizes into the schema rather than inferring from scratch.

Title: Compliance framework/control admin UI
Description: Compliance framework/control admin UI: browse seeded frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, ISO 27001), add custom frameworks/controls.

Title: Importer for standard control sets
Description: Import well-known control sets from structured sources (AICPA TSC for SOC 2, NIST CSF, etc.) rather than hand-seeding - build an importer since these get revised.

Title: Test case to control mapping UI + coverage view
Description: Test case <-> control mapping UI (many-to-many via TestCaseComplianceControl) with coverage-per-control view: which controls have zero mapped test cases.

Title: Control coverage report export
Description: Control coverage report export (PDF/CSV) for auditor handoff.

Title: Evidence attachment model for controls
Description: Evidence attachment model: link a TestResult (a passing execution) as evidence for a control, with immutable timestamped record.

Title: Full audit log for compliance-relevant changes
Description: Full audit log (who changed what test case/plan/control mapping, when) - required for most compliance frameworks' own controls around change management.

Title: Compliance sign-off workflow
Description: Sign-off workflow: a ComplianceAuditor role can formally approve a control's evidence for a given period/release, with a durable signed record.

Title: Configurable evidence retention policy
Description: Retention policy configuration per org (how long evidence/audit logs are kept), since different frameworks mandate different retention windows.

Title: Custom compliance plan type builder
Description: Add your own compliance form flow: org admin defines a new TestPlanType (category COMPLIANCE) with a custom fieldSchema via a form builder, no code change required.

Title: Compliance plan template library
Description: Template library: starter field schemas for common internal audit / vendor-security-questionnaire style plans.

Title: QA strategy plan authoring UI
Description: Strategy plan authoring UI rendering the qa-strategy field schema (risk areas, environments, entry/exit criteria) as a structured, guided form rather than raw JSON.

Title: AI-assisted QA strategy generation
Description: AI-assisted strategy generation: given a project's codebase summary (languages, frameworks detected, existing test coverage) plus a short prompt, draft a starter strategy plan.

Title: AI-assisted risk-area inference
Description: Risk-area inference: cross-reference RiskFlags, historical TestResult failure rates, and compliance control gaps to suggest risk areas automatically.

Title: Link QA strategies to concrete test plans
Description: Strategy-to-plan linking: a QA strategy should be able to spawn/reference concrete TestPlans so the strategy is an actual coordination hub, not just a document.

Title: QA strategy plan versioning/history
Description: Strategy plan versioning/history (strategies evolve release to release; need to see what changed).

Title: Exit-criteria tracking dashboard (per strategy)
Description: Exit-criteria tracking dashboard: live status of each strategy's exit criteria against current test/coverage data.

Title: Generic JUnit XML ingestion endpoint
Description: Generic JUnit XML ingestion endpoint (de facto universal format - Jest, pytest, Go, Cypress, Playwright, most CI systems can emit or convert to it).

Title: GitHub Actions result-posting action
Description: GitHub Actions integration: a reusable workflow step/action that posts TestRun/TestResults to the API at the end of a CI run.

Title: CircleCI + Jenkins ingestion adapters
Description: CircleCI + Jenkins ingestion adapters (translate their native result formats/webhooks to the same TestRun shape).

Title: Match incoming results to TestCase records
Description: Test result <-> TestCase matching: map an incoming externalTestId to an existing TestCase.source record; surface unmatched results for manual linking.

Title: Flaky test detection
Description: Flaky test detection: flag a TestCase as flaky when its results alternate PASS/FAIL across runs on the same commit/branch beyond a threshold.

Title: Coverage data ingestion
Description: Coverage data ingestion (Istanbul/nyc, coverage.py, JaCoCo) - separate from pass/fail results, feeds release-readiness coverage-gap logic.

Title: Failure evidence capture (screenshot/video)
Description: A thin reporter/plugin for major front-end test runners (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO) that captures a screenshot/rolling video buffer on every run but only uploads as a TestResultArtifact when the test fails. Passing runs discard the capture. Headless runs simply produce nothing. Schema already in place; this is the runner-side capture + ingestion upload path.

Title: Continuous coverage listening (auto-reverse-engineer unmatched CI results)
Description: When a TestResult arrives with no TestCaseSource match, fetch its source via the repo connector and auto-enqueue a scoped ReverseEngineerJob (CI_UNMATCHED_RESULT) instead of just queuing it for manual linking. The resulting TestCase enters the normal AI-review queue, and its TestCaseSource.externalTestId is set on success so the next run matches immediately. Turns reverse-engineering into a standing guarantee instead of an opt-in action.

Title: Native JS/TS test structure parser
Description: Native JS/TS parser (via @babel/parser or ts-morph) for Jest/Vitest/Mocha structure extraction, then hands only extracted structure to the AI agent for BDD phrasing.

Title: Native Python test structure parser
Description: Native Python parser (ast module via a small Python microservice, or a JS-side heuristic) for pytest structure extraction.

Title: Native JUnit/TestNG structure parser
Description: Native JUnit/TestNG (Java) annotation-based extraction.

Title: Native Cypress/Playwright structure parser
Description: Cypress/Playwright structural extraction (likely shares the JS parser with framework-specific step detection for cy.*/page.* calls).

Title: Framework evaluator plugin registry
Description: Framework evaluator registry/interface so adding a new native evaluator is a plugin, not a router change.

Title: Teach-the-platform custom framework flow
Description: Teach the platform your framework flow: user provides example test files from a custom framework; the agent infers the structural pattern and stores it as a reusable per-project heuristic.

Title: Graduate custom framework to saved evaluator
Description: Custom framework confidence tracking + prompt to graduate a well-understood custom framework into a saved evaluator config.

Title: GitHub App with PR webhooks
Description: GitHub App: install on a repo, receive pull_request webhooks (opened/synchronize), verify webhook signatures.

Title: Diff analysis to find affected test cases
Description: Diff analysis: fetch changed files for a PR, map file paths to existing TestCaseSource.filePaths to find directly-affected test cases.

Title: Coverage-gap RiskFlag creation from PR diffs
Description: Coverage-gap detection: changed files/functions with no mapped TestCaseSource -> create a RiskFlag (PR_SCAN_COVERAGE_GAP) with severity based on file criticality.

Title: AI-assisted test plan recommendation from diff
Description: AI-assisted test plan recommendation: given the diff, ask the agent which existing test plans are relevant and whether new test cases are warranted.

Title: PR comment bot with recommendations
Description: PR comment bot: post the recommendation (relevant test plans, coverage gaps, suggested new test cases) as a GitHub PR comment.

Title: Configurable PR scan policy per project
Description: Configurable PR scan policy per project (which branches trigger scans, risk-weighting rules, comment vs. silent-flag-only mode).

Title: GitLab merge request scanning
Description: GitLab equivalent (merge request webhooks) - mostly adapter work if the GitHub path is built with the provider abstracted.

Title: Release management UI
Description: Release management UI: create/manage Releases, attach TestPlans (including a release-readiness typed plan) and acceptance criteria.

Title: Auto-computed acceptance criteria status
Description: Live acceptance-criteria status: each AcceptanceCriterion auto-computes MET/NOT_MET/AT_RISK from underlying test results rather than requiring manual status updates.

Title: Release readiness score
Description: Release readiness score: single rollup number/traffic-light per release from criteria status + open risk flags + compliance control coverage.

Title: Release readiness dashboard page
Description: Release readiness dashboard page: readiness score, acceptance criteria checklist, open risk flags, trend vs. previous releases.

Title: Dashboard drill-down to source
Description: Granular drill-down: from the dashboard, click into any risk flag/failing test/uncovered file down to the actual TestCase/TestCaseSource.

Title: Org-level holistic readiness view
Description: Holistic cross-project view: an org-level dashboard rolling up readiness across all projects/releases.

Title: Release-to-release trend charts
Description: Release-to-release trend charts: pass rate, flaky test count, coverage %, mean time-to-green over the last N releases.

Title: Configurable release gates
Description: Configurable release gates: block a release status from moving to READY while criteria are unmet (soft warning vs. hard block, per-org policy).

Title: Slack/email release readiness digest
Description: Slack/email digest: daily or pre-release readiness summary pushed to a channel.

Title: Mobile auth
Description: Auth in mobile (shares Phase 1's auth, native login flow).

Title: Mobile test case detail/BDD view
Description: Test case detail + BDD view in mobile (parity with web's detail page).

Title: Mobile release readiness dashboard
Description: Release readiness dashboard, mobile-adapted view - highest-value mobile use case is checking release status from your phone.

Title: Mobile push notifications
Description: Push notifications for release-readiness state changes / compliance sign-off requests.

Title: Mobile approval flows
Description: Mobile approval flows: compliance sign-off and AI-reverse-engineered test case review, approvable from mobile.

Title: Mobile offline read caching
Description: Offline-friendly read caching for test case browsing (spotty connectivity shouldn't blank the app).

Title: App store submission prep
Description: App store submission prep (iOS/Android): icons, splash, privacy manifest, EAS build config.

Title: Jira requirement sync
Description: Jira integration: link Requirements to Jira issues bidirectionally, sync status.

Title: Linear requirement sync
Description: Linear integration: link Requirements to Linear issues bidirectionally, sync status.

Title: Slack event notifications
Description: Slack notifications: configurable events (new risk flag, review-queue item, sign-off request) -> Slack channel.

Title: Datadog/PagerDuty incident linkage
Description: Connect a production incident to the test plan/case that should have caught it, closing the loop from incident -> coverage gap -> new test case.

Title: Public API + OpenAPI docs
Description: Public API + API docs (OpenAPI/tRPC-to-OpenAPI) for orgs wanting to build their own integrations.

Title: Outbound webhook system
Description: Webhook system (outbound) so external systems can react to platform events without polling.

Description: Zapier/Make.com app listing, once the webhook system exists - only worth it after real integration demand shows up.

Description: Dependency/vulnerability scanning in CI (npm audit/Snyk/Dependabot) - flag before it's a customer-facing incident.

Description: Metrics/tracing (OpenTelemetry), especially around AI agent latency/cost, since that's the most expensive and most failure-prone path.

Description: Uptime/health checks + alerting for the API and the job worker.

Description: Database backup/restore runbook + tested recovery process - before there's real customer data to lose.

Description: Unit + integration test suite for the API routers and the AI agent's parsing logic.

Title: Shared UI/design system package
Description: Design system / shared UI package (packages/ui) once web has enough screens that inconsistency becomes visible - don't build speculatively before then.

Title: Generic ImportJob model + pipeline

Title: Field-mapping UI for imports
Description: Field-mapping UI: preview parsed records against target TestCase/TestPlan fields, let the user adjust mapping and custom-field targets before committing - nothing writes until confirmed.

Title: Historical run-data backfill

Title: Post-import diff/summary report

Title: Migration assistant wizard

Title: Feature-flag-by-tier plumbing

Title: Data retention enforcement job

Title: Retention policy in compliance UI
